external_inputs.inflammatory: canonical L input with finite pulse and exponential decay tail
external_inputs.amyloid_beta: canonical A_ext rectangular pulse; affects Src only when src_mode is abeta_modulated

parameter_contract: The complete flat Params dataclass is serialized explicitly. Environment-dependent calibration loading is outside this interface.
semantic_boundary: This interface exposes the existing reduced-order controller without changing its equations, parameter meanings, state ordering, input functions, observables, or solver tolerances. N_tox remains a model-derived inflammatory-burden coordinate rather than measured injury, death, or cytokine output.
downstream_rule: Descendant models may infer distributions over compatible kernel states, but must not silently modify this frozen kernel version. Equation changes require a new model-equation version and golden fixture.
